# Ashok Leyland Foundation

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Budget spent (8 searches, 6 documents used) after confirming statutory CSR figures for all three requested years and gathering programme/footprint/metric detail from press coverage; no project-level CSR-spend table or the Foundation's own CIN/registration number could be located within budget.

Ashok Leyland Foundation is confirmed as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Ashok Leyland Limited (CIN L34101TN1948PLC000105), the Chennai-based commercial vehicle maker, set up as the company's dedicated CSR vehicle (education, healthcare, sustainability). NOTE: the research_goals/funder_dossier tools returned held data for a completely different organisation (Adani Foundation, funder:15) under this name before research began -- that appears to be a catalog lookup/fuzzy-match error, not evidence the two are related; none of that Adani data was used or treated as baseline for this entity, and no held baseline for the real Ashok Leyland Foundation was available. Statutory CSR figures for FY2022-23, FY2023-24 and FY2024-25 were sourced from Ashok Leyland Limited's audited Annual Reports (Annexure I to the Board's Report): FY2024-25 total spend Rs.35.27cr (avg net profit Rs.1,899.06cr, prescribed 2% Rs.37.98cr); FY2023-24 total spend Rs.16.30cr (avg net profit Rs.519.31cr, prescribed Rs.10.39cr); FY2022-23 total spend Rs.15.16cr against a prescribed Rs.0.11cr (reconstructed from a footnote only, full breakdown not located). A separate low-quality aggregator article (indiacsr.in) claimed FY2024-25 CSR spend of only Rs.20.64cr via 'Hinduja Foundation' as implementing partner -- this conflicts with, and is less authoritative than, the audited annexure figure of Rs.35.27cr and was not saved as a finding, only flagged here. Programme detail (Road to School since 2015, Road to Livelihood since 2022, operating across 25 districts in 9 states, ~6.26 lakh students, three focus themes education/healthcare/sustainability) came from a 2026 press briefing reported by three outlets, so is current/cumulative rather than tied to a specific one of the three requested fiscal years. No project-wise CSR spend table, no Foundation-specific CIN/darpan number, and no grant-level or FY-specific stated-geography/footprint data were found.

Website: https://www.ashokleylandfoundation.com

## What it set out to find

- identity: legal name, funder_type, parent company, website, section 135 status
- identifiers: PAN/CIN/CSR1/darpan/domain
- csr_year: FY2022-23, FY2023-24, FY2024-25 statutory figures (avg net profit, prescribed CSR, spend, overheads, impact assessment, unspent/excess)
- csr_spend: project or aggregate spend by year, sector, implementing agency
- footprint: states/districts where programmes actually ran, by year
- stated_geography: priority states/regions
- partner: NGOs/agencies partnered with, by year
- program: named programmes/themes and hierarchy
- metric: output/outcome/impact figures
- contact: disclosed office bearers
- document: primary sources (annual reports, CSR annexures, website)
